title: T115 Tasks page: due dates, work states, task links, reminders and Add by voice
head: t115-design
body:
T115 adds a Tasks page with due dates, work states, task links, reminders and Add by voice.

## What

- Add the T104 UI to the T115 Tasks page.
- Use `serviceClient` Pipeline types and parsers for `due_date`, `work_state`, `task_links` and server-derived `map_status`. Reject forged fields and use fixed error codes without echoing task text.
- Use layout C: a list, detail panel and filter bar for company, priority, completion, date field, dates, sort and direction. Due date is the server default sort.
- Add `TaskForm` and `TaskDetailPanel` fields for due date, work state (no Done option) and explicit task-link picks. Show “No due date”.
- Show a Task Map placeholder behind a flag. The real map is in stacked PR desktop#86.
- Add `TaskReminderBanner` and `useTaskReminders`, mounted in `App`. Reminders come only from `reminder_at` while the app is open, never `due_date`. Dismissal is per reminder value until the next session. Suppress completed tasks. A reminder never executes or completes a task.
- Add Tasks to the `AppRail`. “Add by voice” opens a normal chat with the editable draft `Add this to my list: `, using the existing native voice seam as the Quick window does. Keep the Composer unchanged. She presses Send herself. Voice telemetry contains only engine, on_device, chars and duration_ms.
- A reminder opens its task in Tasks detail. Pick up never sends or confirms.

## Safety

Task text is React text only. Nothing here sends, completes, unlocks or skips a step; ask-first stays in the runner. Ticks stay in her private drawer (#373).
